description: This file contains a test class 'FvpDevicesTest' that performs hardware device and CPU hotplug tests on a system, including device presence checks, CPU enable/disable, and device-specific tests like RTC, watchdog, networking, and RNG, using SSH commands and system file interactions.

classes.name: FvpDevicesTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying device presence, CPU hotplug functionality, and specific device tests (RTC, watchdog, networking, RNG) on a system.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command on the target system with optional retries and checks for success.

methods.name: check_devices
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a minimum number of devices of a specific class and verifies that at least one device uses specified drivers.

methods.name: check_rng
methods.description: Checks for the presence of RNG devices by grepping system files.

methods.name: set_cpu
methods.description: Enables or disables a CPU core by writing to system files.

methods.name: test_cpu_hotplug
methods.description: Tests CPU hotplug functionality by enabling/disabling cores and ensuring system stability.

methods.name: test_rtc
methods.description: Verifies RTC device presence and functionality.

methods.name: test_networking
methods.description: Verifies networking device presence and outbound connectivity.
